# Shipment Document Control

> Checks a shipment's document pack against the shipping instruction held on a SharePoint list,
> gets the drafts approved by a named person, then chases the originals via Outlook. Presence by
> set arithmetic, agreement by fixed rules, a language model only where the reading is.

## What it is

An n8n workflow for supply chain and logistics document desks. One OneDrive folder per shipment
with drafts and originals inside. A daily scan, plus a trigger that re-runs within minutes of a
file landing, names each file from its filename through an alias table, checks the required
documents are present against per-contract requirement rows, reads the fields each row names out
of the present drafts with a model, and compares them with the values a person typed on the
Shipments list. The row's next_step column is the worklist. A named person approves on a form;
the counterparty is asked for the originals and chased on a schedule until they arrive. Every
change lands on an append-only log.

## What it is not

Not a document authoring tool, not a letter of credit presentation, not customs or freight
software, not an OCR archive. Originals are checked for presence, not read. The model never
decides presence, agreement or approval.

## Key facts

- Stack: n8n 1.90+, Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft SharePoint Lists, Microsoft Outlook (optional),
  any Messages-API model endpoint. No database.
- 51 nodes, one importable JSON. Three SharePoint lists: Shipments (the instruction and the
  worklist), Document requirements (one row per document type per contract), Document log.
- Document types are rows, never branches. Adding a document to a contract is a row on a list.
- EU AI Act Article 50: the one message that quotes model-read values carries a readable line, an
  X-AI-Generated header and a machine-readable envelope; rule-written messages are unmarked.
- Licence: MIT. Author: Aleks Sidorecs, Automatiqa Lab. Contact: aleks@automatiqa.io.

## Files

- README.md: what it does, what it looks like, install.
- SCOPE.md: limits, by name.
- COMPLIANCE.md: EU AI Act role classification and marking architecture.
- workflows/ship-doc.json: the workflow.
- lists/: seed CSVs and column types for the three lists.
